_comment: Classes, per brief section 30. Each defines stat tendencies, equipment,
movement, abilities and promotions. Only the classes the prologue needs are
here; the full roster of brief section 30 arrives with the characters that
growth values are percentage chances of gaining a point on level up (brief
section 32). Bounded randomness, so an unlucky run cannot make a character

classes.name: Swordsman
classes.notes: Rowan. Brief section 31 lists a secret Dragon Knight path unlocked by a hidden item.

classes.name: Apprentice Mage
classes.notes: Maeve starts here rather than at Mage. Promoting to Mage is an early reward, and the Wizard / Sorcerer / Elementalist paths of brief section 31 branch from Mage.

classes.name: Soldier
classes.notes: Tomas. Spear range 2 is what teaches weapon range in battle 01.

classes.name: Officer
classes.notes: Aldric and Varric. Not player-controlled in the prologue.

classes.name: Guard
classes.notes: Greenvale rank and file. Enemies in battle 02, then allies.

classes.name: Aberration
classes.notes: The Wallstalker's class. directional_armour is added to defence based on the attacker's facing relative to the unit, which is the whole positioning tutorial. It is introduced here and reused for later sealed-fragment creatures, so it belongs on the class rather than on the one unit.
